New York City, 2003
The Forgotten Line

Kyle: Transit sealed both ends.
That train has no power, Aya.

Aya: Then who just called me
from the platform?

Eve: I heard it too. It used
my voice. Follow it.

Aya: Someone spliced a recorder
into the station speakers.

Recorder: Lazarus intake.
Subject recalls the drowning.

Aya: That's my voice.
I have never been here.

Kyle: Take the service steps.
Follow the tracks to the signal.

Eve: It stopped moving, Aya.
Why can I still hear it?

Aya: The voice is in the line.
I'm taking the recording.

Kyle: I traced the signal.
Saint Dymphna Hospital.

Aya: Keep that channel open.
If you hear me again, ask when.

The Forgotten Line
End of the playable section.
